id1.description:
To record the result of a laboratory test which may be used to record a single valued test but will often be specialised or templated to represent multiple value or 'panel' tests.
This archetype also acts as the parent for specialisations appropriate for more specific laboratory tests microbiology, histopathology.

id6.description: Specific identifier for this lab test. e.g. Full blood count , blood glucose, urine microbiology.  May equate to the result name for a single value result. Commonly a coded term e.g from LOINC or SNOMED-CT.

id7.description: The type of high-level diagnostic service e.g. biochemistry, haematology.

id8.description: The status of the lab test as a whole.

id9.description: Details of the specimen being reported where all individual results are derived from the same specimen.

id11.description: Slot to allow an annotation to be added to a particular test result at run-time.

id12.description: An overall interpretative comment on this test.

id13.description: Representations of the whole test in mutlimedia e.g image, audio, video.

ac1.description: The status of the lab test as a whole. (synthesised)

at38.description: This is an initial or interim result - further updates are anticipated.

at39.description: This is the final result. No further alterations are anticipated.

at40.description: This is a supplementary result ehich should be appended to a previous result.

at41.description: This is a correction which should completely replace any previous results.

at75.description: The test was aborted and never completed.
